Our Story

BUILDING
LEGACIES
IN PRINT

With over two decades of expertise, Rajendra Digital has grown from a single printing unit to a multi-city powerhouse — constantly evolving with technology and market needs.

Rajendra Digital is an emerging name in Large Format Printing with more than 20 years of experience. The company has pioneered itself in providing service to its clients with cost-effective and premium quality Outdoor and Indoor Printing solutions.

We are your partner in the journey to e-space, assuring a lasting footprint in every campaign we execute. Our commitment to quality and innovation sets us apart as a reliable choice for all printing needs.

2002

Founded in Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh

Established as a trusted printing solution provider offering impressive services aligned with state-of-the-art technologies. Built a reputation for adapting to media and market changes.

2013

UV Flatbed Printing in Hyderabad, Telangana

Expanded into UV printing services with 6-color printing capabilities on all flat surface media including Glass, Tiles, ACP Sheets, and Foam Boards.

2018

Large Format Printing Hub in Goregaon, Mumbai

Launched a full in-house production system with dedicated design unit in Maharashtra — manned by industry's finest, driven by superior quality and complete customer satisfaction.
